# Safety rules: what the controller does, and when

<!-- Generated by tools/safety_rules.py from firmware/components/safety/src/safety_rules.def. Do not edit: change the table and run `python3 tools/safety_rules.py gen`. -->

Every condition the S3 controller reacts to, and what it does. The state
machine runs from the same table this page is generated from
([`safety_rules.def`](../firmware/components/safety/src/safety_rules.def)), so
the transitions below are exactly what the firmware does. Values in **bold**
are the menuconfig defaults; the dashboard can change every one of them (see the
last section) and shows the values in force. The
reasons behind the rules are in [safety_state_machine.md](safety_state_machine.md).

## Outputs per state

| State | Buzzer | Shutdown output (latched) |
|---|---|---|
| BOOT | off | released |
| SELF_TEST | off | released |
| IDLE | off | released |
| MONITORING | off | released |
| UNATTENDED | off | released |
| WARNING | warning pattern | released |
| SHUTDOWN | shutdown pattern | **active** |
| FAULT | fault pattern | released |

## A. What the controller believes about its inputs

| # | When | Result | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | A node sends nothing for **2 s** (stale) or **10 s** (offline), or its sensor reports invalid | That sensor's reading is UNKNOWN | `sensor_node_evaluate()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A2 | "At the stove" (**"every working radar sees them"**): any working radar says absent | ABSENT | `presence_fuse_all()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A3 | "At the stove": every working radar sees someone (a radar that is down is not asked) | PRESENT | `presence_fuse_all()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A4 | No radar is working | UNKNOWN: a dashboard flag, never FAULT | `presence_fuse_all()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A5 | Fusion set to "either radar sees them" (menuconfig or dashboard) | PRESENT if any radar sees someone; ABSENT only if all validly say absent | `presence_fuse()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A6 | Radar rules set to enforce (default **"observe: computed and reported, not used"**): a radar sees someone but not for **4 s** with **1.5 s** stationary and within **60 cm** over **4 s** | That radar counts as absent (only passing). In observe mode the verdict is shown but not used | `node_set_inputs()` in `sensor_node/src/sensor_node.c` |
| A7 | Presence UNKNOWN while cooking | Counts as ABSENT. With nothing cooking, UNKNOWN starts no timer | `effective_presence()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| A8 | Thermal camera lost or invalid | Dashboard flag only. Cooking state, tier and a running countdown are kept | `safety_step()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |

## B. Cooking on or off (hottest pixel)

| # | When | Result | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Not cooking, and the hottest pixel reaches the cooking temperature **50 °C** (dashboard can change it) | Cooking | `safety_step()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| B2 | Not cooking, above the off temperature and rising at least the heat-on rate (**0 °C/min**; 0 = this rule is off) | Cooking | `safety_step()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| B3 | Cooking, and the hottest pixel falls below the off temperature **40 °C** | Not cooking | `safety_step()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| B4 | The dashboard sets a new cooking temperature | The off temperature moves with it, keeping the menuconfig gap (**50 °C** - **40 °C**) | `apply_cooking_temp()` in `rb_controller/src/rb_controller.c` |

## C. Timers

| # | When | Result | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | First ABSENT reading | The absence count starts. A presence blip does not restart it; only a confirmed return (D4) stops it | `safety_step()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C2 | Entering UNATTENDED | The countdown is counted from when the absence began, never from before cooking started | `on_enter()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C3 | Hottest pixel below every hotter tier (tier 1: a simmer, boiling water) | The base times: buzzer after **150 s**, shutdown after **300 s** | `update_tier()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C4 | Hottest pixel at least **100 °C** (tier 2), **150 °C** (tier 3), **200 °C** (tier 4) or **250 °C** (tier 5), for **4 s** | Buzzer / shutdown after **120 s** / **240 s** (tier 2), **90 s** / **180 s** (tier 3), **60 s** / **120 s** (tier 4), **30 s** / **60 s** (tier 5), if shorter than the base times. The hottest tier that applies wins | `update_tier()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C5 | Rate rule (**on** by default): the temperature, plus its rise over the last **30 s** times a tier's buzzer time, reaches that tier's temperature, for **4 s** | That tier already: the buzzer sounds no later than the moment the pan would get there. The rise is the median of the newer half of the window minus the median of the older half, so one bad frame fakes no rise. Only a rise counts | `tier_for()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C6 | **10 °C** below the tier's threshold (and not heading back, C5) for **20 s** | Back to the lower tier | `update_tier()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C7 | The tier changes during a countdown | The countdown is not restarted: the time already away counts against the new limits. If they are already passed the buzzer sounds at once, and the shutdown waits for **10 s** of buzzer | `evaluate()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| C8 | Someone is seen during UNATTENDED or WARNING | The countdown stands still. At most **30 s** per countdown, and at most **25 %** of the shutdown time | `pause_clock()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |

## D. Holds and returns

| # | When | Result | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Cooling: over the last **120 s** (at least **12** samples over **60 s**) the predicted settling temperature T + tau x rate is more than **3 °C** below the off temperature, and it rose at most **8 °C/min** over the last minute. tau comes from the cookware profile (**"mixed / unknown (10 min)"**) | The pan counts as only cooling. Ends when the prediction is back **3 °C** above the off temperature or climbs faster than **16 °C/min**. With too little data, a lost camera or the trend judgment turned off (it is **on** by default), heat counts as going in | `judge_heat()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| D2 | A buzzer or shutdown comes due while the pan is only cooling (D1) | It waits (cooling hold), at most **4** tau and never over **3600 s**. The countdown keeps counting; a buzzer already sounding keeps sounding | `hold_reason()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| D3 | A step comes due while someone is seen but not yet confirmed (D4) | It waits (return hold), at most **5 s** + **1 s** | `hold_reason()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| D4 | Someone returns: PRESENT for **5 s**, absent gaps under **1 s** forgiven, still present at the end | Return confirmed (used by T10, T13) | `present_confirmed()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |
| D5 | A buzzer or shutdown comes due while the temperature is falling at least **2 °C/min** (over the last **30 s**), and the trend has not confirmed heat going in (the prediction of D1 at least **3 °C** above the off temperature and moving at most **8 °C/min**) | It waits (falling hold; **on** by default): a falling pan is moving away from danger. Ends at once when the temperature stops falling or heat is confirmed (a lowered flame), and after **90 s** at most per countdown. A pan that is only cooling (D1) gets the cooling hold instead | `falling_hold()` in `safety/src/safety.c` |

## T. State transitions

Checked on every step in this order; the first rule of the current state that holds is taken.

| # | From | When | To | Reported reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T01 | BOOT | Always | **SELF_TEST** | boot complete |
| T02 | SELF_TEST | The self-test reports FAIL | **FAULT** | self-test failed |
| T03 | SELF_TEST | The self-test reports PASS | **IDLE** | self-test passed |
| T04 | SELF_TEST | No self-test result within **10 s** | **FAULT** | self-test timeout |
| T05 | any cooking-related state (IDLE, MONITORING, UNATTENDED, WARNING) | The self-test (the shutdown output's read-back, every **1 s**) no longer passes | **FAULT** | self-test not passed |
| T06 | any cooking-related state (IDLE, MONITORING, UNATTENDED, WARNING) | A controller fault in the fault list (shutdown output, self-test). A lost sensor is not one (A4, A8) | **FAULT** | safety-relevant fault active |
| T07 | IDLE | Cooking (B1, B2) | **MONITORING** | heating detected |
| T08 | MONITORING | Not cooking (B3) | **IDLE** | heating stopped |
| T09 | MONITORING | ABSENT for **1 s** (C1) | **UNATTENDED** | person absent |
| T10 | UNATTENDED | Return confirmed (D4). The countdown is cancelled | **MONITORING** | person returned |
| T11 | UNATTENDED | Not cooking (B3), with the cooling policy **"return to IDLE and cancel the timers"**. The countdown is cancelled | **IDLE** | heating stopped while unattended |
| T12 | UNATTENDED | Unattended for the warning time (**150 s**, shorter in a hotter tier C4, C5) and no hold (D2, D3, D5) | **WARNING** | unattended timeout |
| T13 | WARNING | Return confirmed (D4). The warning exit is **"return to MONITORING"**; if it is changed to acknowledge, a reset is needed as well | **MONITORING** | person returned during warning |
| T14 | WARNING | Not cooking (B3), with the cooling policy **"return to IDLE and cancel the timers"**. The countdown is cancelled | **IDLE** | heating stopped during warning |
| T15 | WARNING | Unattended for the shutdown time (**300 s**, counted from **"start of UNATTENDED (total unattended time)"**, shorter in a hotter tier), no hold (D2, D3, D5), and the buzzer has sounded at least **30 s** if a hold happened, or **10 s** if a tier made the shutdown due at once | **SHUTDOWN** | shutdown timeout |
| T16 | SHUTDOWN | Operator reset (dashboard button or console reset). Nothing else leaves SHUTDOWN; a reboot also clears it. All timing starts over | **IDLE** | operator reset |
| T17 | FAULT | Fault cleared, not cooking | **IDLE** | fault cleared, no heating |
| T18 | FAULT | Fault cleared, cooking, PRESENT | **MONITORING** | fault cleared, person present |
| T19 | FAULT | Fault cleared, cooking, nobody seen. A countdown already running carries on; otherwise it counts from when the fault began | **UNATTENDED** | fault cleared, person absent |
| T20 | FAULT | The countdown reached its shutdown time: a fault never postpones it | **SHUTDOWN** | shutdown timeout reached during fault |
| T21 | FAULT | In FAULT for **90 s** (0 = never) | **SHUTDOWN** | fault persisted |

SHUTDOWN is left only by T16. A state not in the table goes to FAULT ("invalid state").

## X. Outside the state machine

| # | When | Result | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | Wireless gas valve: in SHUTDOWN, or the safety task stops reporting | Valve CLOSE; otherwise KEEP_OPEN every **1 s** | `link_task()` in `rb_valve_link/src/rb_valve_link.c` |
| X2 | MQTT, Django, the laptop or the network is down | No effect on any rule: the safety task never waits on them, and the settings the dashboard gave it stay in force (saved on the controller) | `safety_task()` in `rb_controller/src/rb_controller.c` |

| `RB_CTRL_NODE_STALE_MS` | 2000 | Node STALE after (ms) without a packet |
| `RB_CTRL_PRESENCE_FUSION` | every working radar sees them | Someone counts as at the stove when ... |
| `RB_CTRL_RADAR_DWELL_MS` | 4000 | Time in the cook zone needed to count as dwelling (ms) |
| `RB_CTRL_RADAR_RULES` | observe: computed and reported, not used | Radar state and distance rules (placeholder, untuned) |
| `RB_CTRL_RADAR_SETTLE_SPAN_CM` | 60 | ... to within a span of (cm) |
| `RB_CTRL_RADAR_SETTLE_WINDOW_MS` | 4000 | The distance must have settled over the last (ms) ... |
| `RB_CTRL_RADAR_STATIONARY_MIN_MS` | 1500 | ... of which as a stationary target at least (ms) |
| `RB_CTRL_VALVE_KEEPALIVE_MS` | 1000 | Keep-open / command period (ms) |
| `RB_SAFETY_ABSENCE_DEBOUNCE_MS` | 1000 | Absence must last (ms) before UNATTENDED |

## Fixed constants in safety.c

| Constant | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `TIER_UP_PERSIST_MS` | 4000 | a hotter tier takes over after holding this long |
| `TIER_DOWN_PERSIST_MS` | 20000 | a cooler one only after this long ... |
| `TIER_HYST_C` | 10.0 | ... and this far below the threshold |
| `LATE_WARNING_MIN_MS` | 10000 | buzzer before a shutdown that was already due |
| `TREND_SAMPLE_MS` | 2000 | one sample per 2 s |
| `TREND_GAP_RESET_MS` | 15000 | a longer silence starts the trend over |
| `TREND_STALE_MS` | 30000 | no sample for this long: the trend is unknown |
| `TREND_DEFAULT_WINDOW_MS` | 120000 | regression window when the config leaves it 0 |
| `TREND_MIN_SPAN_MS` | 60000 | needs at least this much history ... |
| `TREND_MIN_SAMPLES` | 12 | ... and this many samples |
| `TREND_HALF_LIFE_MS` | 30000.0 | recent samples count more: a pan that was steady and now cools shows up sooner |
| `SETTLE_MARGIN_C` | 3.0 | hysteresis on the cooling decision |
| `SETTLE_HIST_SAMPLE_MS` | 5000 | the settling estimate is remembered every 5 s ... |
| `SETTLE_DRIFT_WINDOW_MS` | 60000 | ... and its rise measured over a minute |
| `SETTLE_MAX_DRIFT_C_PER_MIN` | 8.0 | to start believing "cooling" |
| `SETTLE_EXIT_DRIFT_C_PER_MIN` | 16.0 | to stop believing it (hysteresis: camera noise must not drop a hold) |
| `RISING_C_PER_MIN` | 0.5 | faster than this is "heating", otherwise "holding" |
| `COOLING_HOLD_MAX_MS` | 3600000 | a cooling hold never lasts longer than an hour ... |
| `COOLING_HOLD_TAUS` | 4.0 | ... nor longer than 4 time constants: a pan still hot after that is not just cooling |
| `WARNING_MIN_AFTER_HOLD_MS` | 30000 | buzzer before the shutdown after any hold |
| `TIER_RATE_WINDOW_MS` | 30000 | rate for the tiers and the falling hold fitted over the last 30 s |
| `FALLING_RATE_C_PER_MIN` | 2.0 | falling at least this fast counts as falling |
| `FALLING_HOLD_MAX_MS` | 90000 | a falling hold lasts at most this long per timeline |
| `SAFETY_FAST_RATE_MAX` | 64 | samples in that window at most: up to 126 s |

## Changing them from the dashboard

The dashboard's Tuning cards change the cooking temperature, cookware profile, temperature tiers,
presence filter and buzzer/shutdown times, fusion and pause budget, and the radar rules. Every other
setting above is on the Logic tab's **Other settings** card
([`rb_params.def`](../firmware/components/rb_params/include/rb_params.def)); the controller saves
them until **Defaults** is pressed.

| Setting | Key | Default | Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shutdown time counts from | `shutdown_timing` | start of UNATTENDED (total unattended time) | start of UNATTENDED (total unattended time) / start of WARNING |
| Someone comes back during WARNING | `warning_exit` | return to MONITORING | return to MONITORING / stay in WARNING until the person acknowledges (reset input) |
| The pan cools down while unattended | `cooling_policy` | return to IDLE and cancel the timers | keep the timers running (old behaviour: shuts a cold stove off) / return to IDLE and cancel the timers |
| Judge from the temperature trend | `cooking_trend` | on | off / on |
| Also cooking when rising this fast, 0 = off | `heat_on_rate_dc_per_min` | 0 °C/min | 0 °C/min to 1000 °C/min |
| Cooking is over this far below the cooking temperature | `heat_off_gap_dc` | 10 °C | 0 °C to 100 °C |
| FAULT shuts down after, 0 = never | `fault_shutdown_ms` | 90 s | 0 s to 3600 s |
| Self-test result needed within, at boot | `self_test_timeout_ms` | 10 s | 1 s to 120 s |
| Read back the shutdown output every | `verify_period_ms` | 1 s | 0.1 s to 60 s |
| A sensor node is STALE after silence of | `node_stale_ms` | 2 s | 0.2 s to 60 s |
| A sensor node is OFFLINE after silence of | `node_offline_ms` | 10 s | 0.5 s to 600 s |
| Wireless valve KEEP_OPEN every, under the valve's 3 s | `valve_keepalive_ms` | 1 s | 0.1 s to 2.5 s |
| A hotter tier takes over after holding | `tier_up_persist_ms` | 4 s | 0.1 s to 60 s |
| A cooler tier takes over after holding | `tier_down_persist_ms` | 20 s | 0.1 s to 600 s |
| A cooler tier also needs the pan this far below its threshold | `tier_hyst_dc` | 10 °C | 0.1 °C to 50 °C |
| Buzzer before a shutdown that was already due | `late_warning_min_ms` | 10 s | 1 s to 300 s |
| A rising pan gets the tier it is heading for | `tier_rate` | on | off / on |
| Rise or fall measured over the last | `tier_rate_window_ms` | 30 s | 10 s to 120 s |
| Trend window | `trend_window_ms` | 120 s | 10 s to 250 s |
| Trend needs at least this much history | `trend_min_span_ms` | 60 s | 10 s to 250 s |
| Trend needs at least this many samples (one per 2 s) | `trend_min_samples` | 12 | 3 to 128 |
| Cooling margin around the off temperature | `settle_margin_dc` | 3 °C | 0.1 °C to 50 °C |
| Prediction may climb this fast to start a cooling hold | `settle_max_drift_dc_per_min` | 8 °C/min | 0.1 °C/min to 100 °C/min |
| A cooling hold ends when the prediction climbs faster than | `settle_exit_drift_dc_per_min` | 16 °C/min | 0.1 °C/min to 100 °C/min |
| A cooling hold lasts at most | `cooling_hold_max_ms` | 3600 s | 60 s to 14400 s |
| A cooling hold lasts at most this many time constants | `cooling_hold_taus_x10` | 4 | 0.1 to 20 |
| Buzzer before the shutdown after any hold | `warning_min_after_hold_ms` | 30 s | 1 s to 600 s |
| Hold a due buzzer or shutdown while the pan is falling | `falling_hold` | on | off / on |
| Falling means at least | `falling_rate_dc_per_min` | 2 °C/min | 0.1 °C/min to 100 °C/min |
| A falling hold lasts at most, per countdown | `falling_hold_max_ms` | 90 s | 10 s to 600 s |
